snippet.title: Jump King Quest Release-Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump King Quest is a hardcore RPG that smashes Dark Souls and Super Mario together in the unending chaos of dynamic online co-op! Take the leap into tense exploration of a vicious, vast vertical world where everything wants to drag you down when it launches out of Early Access with 1.0 “Phantom Update” on the 25th of May! 

For more information and trailers, visit the Jump King Quest page on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317640/JUMP_KING_QUEST/

#jumpkingquest #nexile #actionrpg #onlinecoop #platformergames
